old: - **Possible incohering** · "An account can absorb any outcome, and geodesic method is no account: its pattern matchers take each observing and each emanation without filter or selection." → An explaining: method's one break, as 2.7 says it, is not recognisable if met. A reader holding an observing has no way to tell whether it is the break: no existing thing, no instrument and no number is set out; the break is said not possibly existing in the sentence naming it; 2.7's six binaries send each sentence holding a size, a fixing form, a total, a common beat, a keeping or a doer to change and change back until a working finds a thing beside, and to be re-explained by changing, its field's own result going exact with its own subject, and each measurement holds at least one of the six, so each observing a field brings is re-said and none counts against method. The thing claimed is beyond observing by the files' own words: Natural Intelligence's *Intelligence is invisible.* and *A why a self demands asks for a thing outside possibly existing, a reason still under a changing.*, and Natural Physics' *bi-co-momentarying, no term and on no line of resolver, Natural Intelligence 6.1*. With these, by 2.7's own *An account can absorb any outcome*, method as written absorbs each outcome, a claim no observing can test, which the fields count against a claim. A re-saying: a page of breaks, for each core sentence one observing set out before it is read, with its existing thing, its number and the direction it comes from, as Natural Physics sets out at its eighth step, *Experimental opportunity*, at several sections, the best practice in the files. The other side: 2.7 as it stands.

old: - **Possible exploring** · At a superconducting circuit of three levels, a made atom, the jump from the ground level to an excited level is followed by a continuous monitoring of a further level bi-coupled to the ground level. With monitoring and feedback at once, jumps are caught partway and inverted, each such jump left incomplete. — at "A changing is or is not, with no size: a changing by a size brings a ground for measuring its size against, a form still from beside, Natural Intelligence 1.3."
